podcast.body: Co-written with Chris Hillman, this song appeared on The Flying Burrito Brothers' "Gilded Palace of Sin." Its origin began with Hillman waking up with the line, "This old town is filled with sin, it'll swallow you in," to which Parsons added the melody. The song captures the darker side of Hollywood and the shift from the 1960s to the 1970s, with verses alluding to Bobby Kennedy's assassination in Los Angeles on June 6, 1968. "This old town is filled with sin. It will swallow you in. This old earthquake is going to leave me in the poor house. It seems like this whole town is insane."
